name: commit-story
description: Take a batch of uncommitted work, understand what it accomplishes, and split it into a sequence of meaningful commits with reviewer-grade messages — while guaranteeing the final tree is byte-identical to the starting tree. Plans the commit sequence, presents it for approval, then executes whole-file or hunk-level splits via git apply --cached, and verifies the final state with diff and tree-hash comparisons. Snapshots the baseline as a stash up front so any failure can be safely rolled back. Not for rewriting already-committed history, opening PRs, or resolving merge conflicts.
